question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Enchanted
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"enchanted"** means to be delighted or charmed by something, often with a sense of magic or wonder. (मंत्रमुग्ध)

 
 
• **Example: **She was **enchanted **by the beautiful garden filled with blooming flowers.
 
 
 
• **"Appealing"** refers to something that is attractive or interesting. (आकर्षक)
 
 
• **Example: **The idea of a vacation to the beach is very** appealing **to me.
 
 

Therefore, The correct synonym of **'enchanted**' is **'appealing.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Disgusted** (घृणित): To feel a strong sense of dislike or disapproval.

 
 
• **Example:** She was** disgusted** by the sight of the dirty kitchen.
 
 
 
• **Cursed** (शापित): To be under a curse or experiencing misfortune.
 
 
• **Example:** The old house was rumored to be **cursed.**
 
 
 
• **Repelling** (विकर्षक): To drive back or ward off; causing a feeling of aversion.
 
 
• **Example:** The smell of the garbage was** repelling.**
